policy.dpfDisclosure: Yíká charges a non-refundable Damage Protection Fee (a platform fee, not insurance). The renter is liable for damage beyond normal wear and tear. Damage must be reported within 48 hours of return with photo evidence.
policy.tosText:
1. Yíká is a marketplace platform connecting item owners with renters; each rental is a transaction between users. Yíká does not own, inspect, or guarantee any item beyond the lender's description.
2. The renter agrees to return the item(s) in the same condition received, by the agreed return date.
3. A non-refundable Damage Protection Fee applies to every booking. It is a platform fee, not insurance.
4. The renter is responsible for damage beyond normal wear and tear, loss, or non-return. Normal wear (minor wrinkles, deodorant marks, slight scuffs) is not claimable.
5. Damage must be reported within 48 hours of return with photo evidence.
6. Late returns are charged 20–30% of the daily rate per day overdue. Non-return is charged the full retail value (RRP).
7. All fees (rental, shipping, HST, Damage Protection Fee) are disclosed before booking is confirmed, per Ontario Consumer Protection Act.
8. Personal information is collected only to fulfil this rental and handled per PIPEDA.
